text: Usually a great game. As a returning player I found out it has a new ranking system that essentially forces solo players to play squads to rank up. The lag is bad, but the broken voice chat completely ruins the game. In a squad shooter like PUBG, communication is everything. Half the time, my mic icon shows it's picking up sound, but my squad can't hear me and I can't hear them or they can hear me but I can't. It just happens to all of us randomly. Worse is the lobby leader glitch: if one specific friend hosts, we lose all audio until we pass the leader role to a third friend. Breaking team comms is unacceptable. Fix your game.

May as well just give nothing. I guess I can just dismantle every reward for BP, and I'm not seeing any reason not to since BP has some lasting value and function, and doesn't expire (though I could be wrong about that). [UPDATE: GOOD LORD, THE MONETIZATION] I'm developing a respect for the majority of other mobile games after looking through the vouchers I've received (time-limited, of course), the store and various crates, and the events. If it's inexpensive, it's worthless. If it's expensive, I can't justify it. Other games at least offer some value for free/budget players, so the occasional purchase isn't such a disappointing prospect. Other games also tend to offer some newbie packages that are relatively good values for very low prices, and all I'm seeing from this game is time-limited cosmetics and vouchers for events I won't get far in without paying. I'm assuming the PC version is a lot less garbage because the tolerance for mobile-style monetization is surely lower, and this is some of the worst I've seen. [UGH] I gave this a try on a whim. I'm not super into BR games, but I figured maybe it'd be a bit casual since it's on mobile. Which seems to be the case. I actually had fun for the 2 matches I played. Kinda giving a mediocre score at the moment because I played through those 2 matches in a row due to how unclear it was how to simply back out after the tutorial. [CLUTTERED UI, HOW DO I BACK OUT?] The UI is cluttered with buttons, and I just wanted to back out to the main menu to adjust some settings, particularly to the button layout which I didn't find comfy at all (constantly misfiring, everything's all clustered weirdly to me). For the first proper match, the tutorial just kept going, showing me various menus, the season stuff, and all the while I'm just like "LET ME BACK OUT." Then the second match starts, and I'm just investigating the UI going "LET ME BACK OUT." I ended up being invited to play that time, by someone from the previous match, so I decided to just let it proceed. But man, these unstoppable tutorials in mobile games need to stop, and if the "back out" button is super obvious then I dunno, I didn't see it, maybe I shouldn't be doing this while half-asleep. I ended up just closing the game before the third match started because I didn't want to abandon a group mid-match. [AN OFFLINE TEST MODE WOULD BE NICE] Not so much gameplay (though botmatches for practice would be cool), but just a way to test graphics and control settings without jumping into a match first. Surely it's possible. Even just accessing an offline lobby would work, maybe with some bots wandering around to see how it all looks and runs. [AFTER I COOL DOWN, WILL TRY SOME MORE] Will probably try it a bit more, post a proper review when I've got a better feel for it. And after I go through all the menus on my own and learn where everything is. Shoulda just let me back out. Why assume I want to just keep playing uncontrollably, after throwing a bunch of info at me while I'm queued up for a match? Maybe ask me if I want to look at the settings I can change instead instead of assuming I want to keep playing with the defaults? Really one of the most bizarre introductions to a game I've experienced.

The number of times I have fired unintentionally is quite the statistic by itself. Graphics is strictly mediocre - this is Ps2 level, occasionally worse, with terrible pop-in and aliasing. Indeed, I would choose N64 over this, at least those games make up for graphics with excellent quality. Poor graphics may be disguised with art style, which the Colourful setting somewhat does, but it is still unsatisfactory. In a nutshell - there is much better stuff than this in existence, people.

(Since Tencent bases the game off of flashy new items, let us trade some of the extra or unwanted items to a friend who has something we want) I will always keep playing this game. First, I love pubg. Think I have about 1000 hours on PC, and with that in mind, there's a lot the mobile version does well that even the pc version could learn from. Outside of some performance concerns on my S7, is a great game theoretically. Biggest qualm with the title is the lopsided competition. Whether it's hacks, or more likely, emulation, there's a clear wall in skill when you're progressing early on in this title. You'll start by winning or nearly winning all your matches (primarily populated by bots of course), but the moment you start getting into more player populated servers, you'll with quickly find a sharp uptick in opponent skill. They'll move and aim with a fluidity not inherent to mobile, moving and shooting with precision honest mobile players might struggle to accomplish given the limits of touch input. I'm guessing emulation is the primary culprit rather than outright cheating, and it's result is an wildly unbalanced playing field. If PC vs console is a slaughterhouse, PC vs mobile is an absolute genocide, and spectating one of these players shows an experience that would be right at home with mouse and keyboard. The imbalance ruins an otherwise enjoyable experience, and if I didn't enjoy PC pubg so much (bugs and all) I'd consider joining this dark side and collect easy wins.

Gameplay is amazing! The graphics are insane for a mobile game. I love how you can tweak just about every setting from graphics down to controls on the screen. Also there are zero ads! An absolute must-have for first person shooter lovers! As mobile game pads and mods are becoming more and more prevalent in this day and age, it would be nice to have Gamepad support.

I think there's still an issue with a stable network establishment, I like how the domination mode has a vivid texture and graphics but at the same time, the classic matches are a bit dull in terms of vividness. Since there're so many players in Asia server, there's a lag issue in matchmaking and stuff. These are some of the problems which we are facing, really hoping that the problems get solved.

After the zombie update, the game sucks. It crashes often leading to a black screen which doesn't respond. Lags are seen while driving vehicles. Before this update, it was quite smooth. I wouldn't write this but while I fired up the app, it crashed continuously for two times so I took out time to type this. Hope so it will be taken care of in the future updates.

I would have given it 5 stars but after the recent update the game is frequently lagging and there are bugs as teleporting from one house to another and unable to land from the parachute. Also, it becomes very lag when there are enemies nearby. Even more lag when there are many enemies around you. This disrupt the efficiency of the game and can be quite annoying. It also spoils the mood as it is hard to obtain chicken dinner when you're lagging 😂 even shooting an enemy is a struggle. I hope you can do something to fix this as soon as possible as it is an awesome game and my friends and I enjoy playing it. It is like our meet-up spot. We hope to have a lag-free pubg soon. Best game of Android since Android cupcake. Theres nothing like Pubg on mobile gaming. I'd also like to make a small suggestion. Please, make the controls easier. I've been playing for about 10 months and I noticed for most players getting used to the controls takes a very long time. If you could modify the fire button to be used as joystick while firing we might be able to do other things at the same time. We can use only two fingers at once so please help. Above all, thanks for everything.

The game is superb there is no doubt. But cons are also there. The game gets lag more and more with the updates. It threw me out of the game 2-3 times. Pubg can be a great experience, and sometimes a terrible one. When it's running good(generally 2 weeks after major updates) it's unbelievable that this is on a phone. Other times, you just try to land on the map and you and your teammates bounce to your deaths. Over all it's easy to kill hours on this game and have a fun time doing it. But sometimes you'll rage quit by throwing your phone through the wall.

Overall a very good game. I've enjoyed playing this game alot, but recent updates have made the game noticeably slower and a bit laggier. Some time while in a match, my FPS goes from a well 60 to less than 30 FPS. It gets pretty annoying from time to time. probably the reason for this is because the game is being packed with WAY too much stuff that sometimes users don't even use... again.. very fun game, but I think it would be better to have it simple, not too many stuff within the game..

This game is undoubtedly the king of all mobile games and the developers have managed to keep it that way by updating the game from time to time. But, I still have a few complaints. Firstly, the high ping and screen freeze issue that happens quite often frustrates me a lot, even though I have a good Internet connection. Secondly, the increasing number of hackers have spoiled the competitive spirit of the game. Lastly, I want a weather select option on all maps.

Amazing game, but... Bring Infection Mode back. I've stopped playing PUBG for a long time when it was first removed. It was a great mode. Second, the new "Loadout" concept is okay- I prefer the old fashioned picking guns from off the table. Third, it would be great if there was statistics and graphs of the damage and rate of fire of the guns. I know there use to be a armory setting until it was removed in the new update. I would like to get a better understanding of the guns in PUBG.

Only free game that I have come across that isn't pay to win and doesn't even have ads. Apart from that the graphics, controls and gameplay are just too good. As for hackers, they are a problem, but believe me they are much lesser compared to other multiplayer game, this does have an advanced anti-ban system. However, some updates spoil the game like they removed infection mode and zombie mode

I enjoy the game, but whether or not my network is stable, I have issues with the ping that increases and then decreases randomly, lag and other issues during play. Not to mention that many times, when I launch the game, the maps show that I need to download 0.1 Mb that doesn't work and that turns out to be a bug that forces me to close and relaunch the game.

Overall it feels a bit better than other mobile shooters. But of course, this is a multiplayer shooter, and this kind of game doesn’t have a great track record with touchscreen controls. Overall it feels a bit better than other mobile shooters, but still not that great. You can easily move around using the joystick, rotating the camera by dragging your right thumb across the screen, and there are on-screen buttons for things like opening your backpack, crouching, going prone, and even jumping.

The game is good and I would have given it four stars, but after the recent updates and changes I changed my mind. There was one particular update I loved, that's where you could've changed scopes without having to into your back pack. I really loved that feature cause when you're playing solo and you're going up against an entire squad, it would really save you time and help better your skills. My other reason is the reduction and loading time of loot at hot drops.

I enjoy this game a lot. It keeps me occupied and on my toes. Two problems with it though. My longest kill was 901m but sometimes i can't even see past that with an 8x. This is my Favorite Game and will always be. If there was one thing I could add I would add an offline traning. Fun game, however the touch controls can sometimes make gameplay awkward (especially in high level play) it seems for new players the controls are so hard to grasp i end up winning 98% of the games I play, until you level up to the point of playing with people who are more familiar with the game, then the controls become a real obstacle, unless you have some kind of attachment to help you play it'd be impossible to execute anything quickly enough. An awesome game that gives you the best visual as well as the best sound experience in different maps. You will be addicted playing this. This is THE SINGLE BEST SHOOTER ON THE MARKET. It is crazy fun and addictive. No two matches are alike. This game is great, but it does take a long time to download though and also it takes a very long time to update the things cost to much money and it does not have a tutorial. Awesome game! A perfect test of skills as well as concentration to become the final survivor. Amazing maps with variety of guns and vehicles and challenges. Sincerely, a true gunfighter.

In PUBG you play as a mercenary who parachutes, along with up to 99 other players, onto an island. Once they land, players scavenge for weapons, ammo, armor, and other supplies in a last-man-standing death match. The game’s map starts large, but quickly shrinks as the electrical storm around the island collapses into progressively smaller circles, forcing players together as the game goes on. It’s a simple concept with tons of room for complexity. You land on an island with 99 other people.
